title: Angular concert stage
slide_intent: Enlarge simple forms into a setting because graphic identity can become a physical experience without relying only on a logo.
strategic_value: Spotify can carry the angular vocabulary into a memorable stage silhouette.
demonstration: A live stage places oversized pink angular structures around a performer, with illuminated edges and audience silhouettes below.
practical_value: Explore whether a two-dimensional shape still reads when it becomes architecture.

content_islands.name: Sculptural structures
content_islands.spec: Large sloping forms surround and partially frame the central performance position.

content_islands.name: Lighting and people
content_islands.spec: Pink edge lights separate planes; the crowd at bottom shows the structures’ scale.
